display.title: Episode 359: The Return of Yehudah, Chapter 4
display.summary_short: News of the Jewish Children's Expo, two sisters say the Shema and a pasuk, Sarah discovers baby Yehudah is missing, and little Zalman shows how to wash negel vasser.
display.summary_long: Uncle Yossi opens with news of Tzivos Hashem's second Jewish Children's Expo at the Javits Center in New York, after last year's huge success, with dates and hours for schools and the public. After the Hakochainik march and a recap of the story, two young sisters from Beis Rivka, with their father, recite the Shema and one of the Twelve Pesukim, and their father thanks the program. Story time continues The Return of Yehudah: safe in the wagon deep in the forest, Reb Moshe and Sarah thank Hashem for their escape, until Sarah unwraps the blanket and finds it empty. Baby Yehudah is still in the pit, and going back means facing the cruel poritz. Reb Moshe weeps and prays, 'Avinu Malkeinu, show me which way to turn.' Uncle Yossi reports on the Shiviti signs pouring in, then continues the morning routine with a little play: Zalman shows his mother how his teacher taught the class to wash negel vasser, three times on each hand, and says the brachah, followed by a hand-washing song. The show ends with a call for listeners' essays and poems, Friday's candle time and Dial-a-Jewish-Story.
display.lesson: Wash negel vasser carefully each morning, and in a hard moment turn to Hashem in prayer.
